subject: stf
title: STF.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in WAM-32, paired with v1-p90-1, on the page where Braxton describes the post-Webern/post-Cageian juncture as connected to 'the source-transfer junction of world creativity' — i.e., as a moment where western art music becomes available for genuine cross-aesthetic transfer because its own composite alignment has dissolved. (C)STF (source transfer) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the diagram poses how source transfer would actually be constituted if it were to flow into progressional continuance rather than terminate as private composer-experiment. STF is fed by PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance), TR-INFO (trans-information) → C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism), and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). STF outputs to AFTD (affinity tendencies) → INFO-F (information focus), and laterally to ATTN (attraction). SPT-DY also branches into DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). The structural claim: source transfer in its working form requires *spiritual dynamics* as an upstream input, with that spiritual layer simultaneously producing dynamic functionalism and ritual dynamics — exactly the conditions Braxton identifies in the WM section as world-cultural and absent from western practice. The diagram thus stages the *prerequisites* the post-Cage juncture would have to meet to actually transfer into world creativity rather than merely register as serial-music technique.
